name: WARNING: Olive Garden Famous House Salad (Raw Roughage, Onions & Pepperoncini)
whyItWorks: Famous communal bowl filled with coarse iceberg/romaine lettuce, whole raw red onion rings, pickled whole pepperoncini peppers with seeds, black olives, croutons, and high-acid garlic vinaigrette. Intense mechanical and chemical ulcer trigger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Politely pass on the house salad during flares or stricture recovery. If ordering soup/salad, choose clear chicken broth or substitute a side of plain pasta.
